description: Implementation of the MasqueClient class for managing QUIC MASQUE protocol sessions, including connection setup, session creation, and settings handling.

classes.name: MasqueClient
classes.description: A client class for managing MASQUE protocol sessions over QUIC, including connection setup, session creation, and settings management.

classes.name: MasqueClientSession
classes.description: Represents a MASQUE session within the MasqueClient, handling session-specific details.

methods.name: MasqueClient::Create
methods.description: Factory method to create and initialize a MasqueClient instance, establishing connection and receiving settings.

methods.name: MasqueClient::CreateQuicClientSession
methods.description: Creates a new QUIC client session for MASQUE.

methods.name: MasqueClient::connection_id
methods.description: Returns the connection ID of the MASQUE client session.

methods.name: MasqueClient::authority
methods.description: Returns the authority string derived from the URI template.

methods.name: MasqueClient::OnSettingsReceived
methods.description: Callback invoked when settings are received.

methods.name: MasqueClient::WaitUntilSettingsReceived
methods.description: Blocks until settings are received or connection is lost.
